hook.name: ClawclickHook
hook.description: A two-phase token launch hook that applies a decaying buy/sell tax (50%→6.25%) collected via BeforeSwapDelta during Phase 1 (protected), then transitions to a 1% pool LP fee override after the token achieves 16x market cap growth (graduation). Enforces max transaction and wallet limits that scale dynamically with market cap during Phase 1.
